about: Buy now, pay later providers as they show up on US bank and card statements, for reading the person's own rows (packages/domain/97-bnpl.js; capability list items 85 and 87). Read-only: Upmore never opens, pays, pays off or reschedules a plan. Researched 2026-10-12 by web search; the providers' own pages could not be opened from the build environment (DNS), so every fact names the page it came from and whether that page is the provider's own ('provider') or someone else's ('third_party' or 'merchant'). Descriptor patterns are what statement guides report: no provider publishes its exact statement text for the US, banks shorten and reformat it, and a pattern only names the provider, never a plan, a balance or a number of payments left. A plan's schedule is taken from the product's published terms; the number of payments left is said only when the plan's shape makes it certain (a 4-payment plan whose first payment is in the rows). Re-check every entry on its page; past fresh_days the answer says the terms on file may have changed.

descriptor_source.note: Klarna's own Pay in Full terms (as quoted by the search) say Klarna appears as the merchant on the card statement; the store after '*' or '/' is reported by third parties only

forms.note: The 8-character code after PAY is a PER-PAYMENT reference: a fresh one is minted for every payment (Y8PRUXM0, KJ4OR9CH, SD6B2XRK, WJSJ24AL, 3U3M7JEN, N7Q3CCLN, OIDHK430, 6KHJY9TY, D15Z7DSK, 6GGIXBJA, and the letters-only IAYRAUTH and ZQILNSJX all occur), so it identifies neither the plan nor a store and must never be shown as part of a plan's name. 'PAY' in this shape is a generic word, not a store, and the place after the code is where Affirm sits, not a store either: this shape names no store. A plan in this shape is identified by its installment amount and its cadence, nothing else.

The number after PAYMENTS is a STABLE plan/account id: the same on every payment of that plan (185-54233729 on all three payments of the $61.44 plan in the owner's rows), so payments carrying it are one plan even if an amount were to differ slightly (a fee). The place after it names no store.
